ko.title: 하원, 여성 보좌관 대우 논란으로 척 에드워즈 하원의원에 대해 413대 2로 견책 결의안 가결

segments.src: ## A Rare Show of Bipartisan Unity
segments.tr: ## 보기 드문 초당적 단합

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: House of Representatives voted 413 to 2 to censure Rep.
segments.tr: 하원은 두 명의 젊은 여성 직원에 대한 행실을 두고 초당적 윤리위원회의 조사가 이루어진 후, 척 에드워즈(공화·노스캐롤라이나) 의원에 대한 견책안을 찬성 413표, 반대 2표로 가결했습니다.

segments.src: Chuck Edwards, R-N.C., following a bipartisan ethics investigation into his conduct toward two young female staffers.
segments.tr: 이 압도적인 표결 결과는 양당 의원들 모두 이번 조사 결과를 제명 직전의 가장 강력한 공식적 징계 중 하나인 견책을 내릴 만큼 심각하게 받아들였음을 명백히 보여줍니다.

segments.src: The lopsided tally made clear that lawmakers from both parties viewed the findings as serious enough to warrant one of the chamber's most severe formal rebukes short of expulsion.
segments.tr: 견책 처분을 받으면 해당 의원은 결의안이 낭독되는 동안 하원 본회의장 단상 앞에 서 있어야 하는데, 이는 최근 의회 역사상 단 몇 차례만 사용된 공개적인 문책 방식입니다.

segments.src: Censure requires the member to stand in the well of the House while the resolution is read aloud — a public accounting that has been used only a handful of times in recent congressional history.
segments.tr: 에드워즈 의원에게 이번 표결은 올해 전까지는 전국적인 주목을 거의 받지 못했던 그의 정치 경력에서 극적이고 굴욕적인 전환점이 되었습니다.

segments.src: For Edwards, the vote marks a dramatic and humbling turn in a career that, until this year, had drawn little national attention.
segments.tr: ## 윤리위원회 조사 결과

segments.src: ## What the Ethics Investigation Found
segments.tr: 하원 윤리위원회의 보고서에 따르면, 에드워즈 의원은 오랜 기간 동안 두 명의 전직 보좌진에게 고가의 선물, 사적인 저녁 식사, 직접 쓴 시를 쏟아부었습니다.

segments.src: According to the House Ethics Committee's report, Edwards showered two former aides with expensive gifts, private dinners and personally written poetry over an extended period.
segments.tr: 조사단은 에드워즈 의원과 보좌진 사이에 성적인 관계가 있었다는 증거는 발견되지 않았다고 밝혔음에도 불구하고, 이러한 행동 패턴이 해당 직원들에게 적대적이고 불편한 근무 환경을 조성했다고 결론지었습니다.

segments.src: Investigators concluded that this pattern of behavior created a hostile and uncomfortable work environment for the staffers involved, even though the committee said it found no evidence of a sexual relationship between Edwards and either aide.
segments.tr: 보고서는 현직 국회의원과 하급 직원 간의 권력 불균형이 이러한 결론을 내리는 데 핵심적인 요인이었다고 강조했습니다.

segments.src: The report emphasized that the imbalance of power between a sitting member of Congress and junior staff members was central to its conclusions.
segments.tr: 조사단은 의도와 상관없이 이러한 종류의 선물과 개인적인 관심은 직원들을 난처한 처지에 몰아넣을 수 있으며, 직장을 잃거나 의원실 내 입지가 좁아질 위험을 감수하지 않고서는 이를 쉽게 거절하거나 이의를 제기하기 어렵게 만든다고 지적했습니다.

segments.src: Investigators noted that gifts and personal attention of this kind, regardless of intent, can place employees in an untenable position — unable to easily decline or object without risking their jobs or standing within the office.
segments.tr: 양당의 윤리위원회 위원들은 수개월 동안 수집된 내부 소통 기록과 증인 증언을 포함한 증거들이 공식적인 조치를 뒷받침할 만큼 일관성이 있다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Committee members from both parties said the evidence, including internal communications and witness testimony gathered over months, was consistent enough to support formal action.
segments.tr: 만장일치에 가까운 본회의 표결 결과는 이러한 합의를 반영한 것으로, 단 두 명의 의원만이 견책 결의안에 반대 표를 던졌습니다.

segments.src: The near-unanimous floor vote reflected that consensus, with only two members voting against the censure resolution.
segments.tr: ## 에드워즈 의원의 반응

segments.src: ## Edwards' Response
segments.tr: 에드워즈 의원은 자신의 행동이 오해를 받았으며 누구도 불편하게 만들 의도가 전혀 없었다고 동료 의원들과 기자들에게 말하며 어떠한 잘못도 반복해서 부인해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Edwards has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing, telling colleagues and reporters that his actions were misunderstood and that he never intended to make anyone uncomfortable.
segments.tr: 표결 직후 발표한 성명에서 그는 자신의 행실에 대한 윤리위원회의 몇 가지 묘사에 대해서는 여전히 동의하지 않으면서도 하원의 결정을 존중한다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: In a statement following the vote, he said he respected the House's decision even as he continued to dispute several of the committee's characterizations of his conduct.
segments.tr: 그는 형사 고발을 당하지 않았으며, 윤리위원회 역시 어떠한 범죄 행위도 주장하지 않았습니다.

segments.src: He has not been accused of, nor has the committee alleged, any criminal behavior.
segments.tr: 이러한 종류의 윤리 조사는 형법이 아닌 하원 직원의 근무지 행동 기준에 초점을 맞추고 있으며, 견책 자체는 법적 처벌을 수반하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Ethics investigations of this kind focus on workplace conduct standards for House employees rather than criminal law, and the censure itself carries no legal penalty.
segments.tr: 대신 이는 동료 의원들이 에드워즈 의원에게 보내는 공식적인 불신임의 표시입니다.

segments.src: It is, instead, a formal statement of disapproval from Edwards' peers.
segments.tr: ## 정치적 파장

segments.src: ## Political Fallout
segments.tr: 이번 논란은 이미 에드워즈 의원의 정치적 미래를 바꾸어 놓았습니다.

segments.src: The controversy has already reshaped Edwards' political future.
segments.tr: 그는 윤리위원회 보고서가 발표되기 몇 주 전에 불출마를 선언했으며, 당시 그의 의원실은 이 결정이 진행 중인 조사와는 무관하다고 설명했습니다.

segments.src: He announced weeks before the ethics report's release that he would not seek re-election, a decision his office described as unrelated to the ongoing investigation at the time.
segments.tr: 그 이후로 노스캐롤라이나주의 여러 공화당 인사들이 그의 지역구에서 잠재적 후임자로 자리매김하기 위해 움직이기 시작했습니다.

segments.src: Since then, several North Carolina Republicans have moved to position themselves as potential successors in his district.
segments.tr: 여야 하원 지도부 모두 이번 표결을 의사당 내 근무 환경에 대한 기준을 보여주는 신호로 규정했습니다. 이는 지난 10년 동안 의회 내에서 괴롭힘 관련 사임과 조사가 잇따른 이후 주기적으로 주목을 받아온 주제입니다.

segments.src: House leaders on both sides of the aisle framed the vote as a signal about workplace expectations on Capitol Hill, a topic that has drawn periodic scrutiny since a wave of harassment-related resignations and investigations in Congress over the past decade.
segments.tr: 하원의장실 보좌진과 민주당 지도부 모두 의원들에게 결의안 지지를 독려하며 압도적인 표차를 만드는 데 기여했습니다.

segments.src: Speaker's office aides and Democratic leadership alike encouraged members to support the resolution, contributing to the vote's overwhelming margin.
segments.tr: ## 향후 전망

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: 견책안이 공식 가결되었지만 에드워즈 의원은 임기 말까지 현직 의원직을 유지하며, 상임위원회 배정과 투표권도 그대로 유지합니다.

segments.src: With censure now formalized, Edwards remains a sitting member of Congress through the end of his term, retaining his committee assignments and voting rights.
segments.tr: 제명과 달리 견책은 의원직을 박탈하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Unlike expulsion, censure does not remove a member from office.
segments.tr: 이제 관심은 그의 지역구 공석으로 쏠리고 있으며, 다음 총선에서 의석을 지키려는 공화당 내에서 다가오는 경선에 많은 후보가 몰릴 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: Attention now turns to the open seat in his district, where the coming primary is expected to draw a crowded Republican field as the party looks to hold the seat in the next general election.
segments.tr: 윤리위원회는 추가 조치가 계획되어 있는지 여부를 밝히지 않았으며, 에드워즈 의원실은 그가 남은 임기를 모두 채울 예정이라고 전했습니다.

segments.src: The Ethics Committee has not indicated whether any further action is planned, and Edwards' office says he intends to serve out the remainder of his term.
segments.tr: 윤리위원회는 추가 조치가 계획되어 있는지 여부를 밝히지 않았으며, 에드워즈 의원실은 그가 남은 임기를 채울 예정이다고 밝혔다.

zh.title: 众议院以 413 比 2 投票谴责众议员查克·爱德华兹对待女性工作人员的行为

segments.src: ## A Rare Show of Bipartisan Unity
segments.tr: ## 罕见的跨党派团结表现

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 美国

segments.src: House of Representatives voted 413 to 2 to censure Rep.
segments.tr: 众议院以 413 比 2 的投票结果谴责众议员

segments.src: Chuck Edwards, R-N.C., following a bipartisan ethics investigation into his conduct toward two young female staffers.
segments.tr: Chuck Edwards（北卡罗来纳州共和党人），此前两党对其针对两名年轻女性工作人员的行为进行了道德调查。

segments.src: The lopsided tally made clear that lawmakers from both parties viewed the findings as serious enough to warrant one of the chamber's most severe formal rebukes short of expulsion.
segments.tr: 悬殊的票数表明，两党议员都认为调查结果足够严重，足以采取除了开除之外最严厉的众议院正式谴责之一。

segments.src: Censure requires the member to stand in the well of the House while the resolution is read aloud — a public accounting that has been used only a handful of times in recent congressional history.
segments.tr: 谴责要求该议员站在众议院议事大厅宣读决议时起立——在近期国会历史上，这种公开说明只使用过几次。

segments.src: For Edwards, the vote marks a dramatic and humbling turn in a career that, until this year, had drawn little national attention.
segments.tr: 对爱德华兹来说，这次投票标志着其职业生涯中急剧而谦卑的转变，直到今年，该职业生涯很少引起全国关注。

segments.src: ## What the Ethics Investigation Found
segments.tr: ## 道德调查发现了什么

segments.src: According to the House Ethics Committee's report, Edwards showered two former aides with expensive gifts, private dinners and personally written poetry over an extended period.
segments.tr: 根据众议院道德委员会的报告，爱德华兹在一段时间内向两名前助手赠送了昂贵的礼物、私人晚宴和亲笔写的诗歌。

segments.src: Investigators concluded that this pattern of behavior created a hostile and uncomfortable work environment for the staffers involved, even though the committee said it found no evidence of a sexual relationship between Edwards and either aide.
segments.tr: 调查人员得出的结论是，这种行为模式为所涉及的工作人员创造了一个充满敌意和令人不舒服的工作环境，尽管委员会表示没有发现爱德华兹与任何一位助手之间存在性关系的证据。

segments.src: The report emphasized that the imbalance of power between a sitting member of Congress and junior staff members was central to its conclusions.
segments.tr: 报告强调，在任国会议员与初级职员之间的权力失衡是其结论的核心。

segments.src: Investigators noted that gifts and personal attention of this kind, regardless of intent, can place employees in an untenable position — unable to easily decline or object without risking their jobs or standing within the office.
segments.tr: 调查人员指出，无论意图如何，这种礼物和个人关注都可能使员工处于尴尬的境地——无法轻易拒绝或反对，而不会危及他们在办公室的工作或地位。

segments.src: Committee members from both parties said the evidence, including internal communications and witness testimony gathered over months, was consistent enough to support formal action.
segments.tr: 两党委员会成员表示，包括数月来收集的内部通讯和证人证言在内的证据，具有足够的一致性来支持正式行动。

segments.src: The near-unanimous floor vote reflected that consensus, with only two members voting against the censure resolution.
segments.tr: 几乎一致的投票结果反映了这种共识，只有两名议员投票反对谴责决议。

segments.src: ## Edwards' Response
segments.tr: ## 爱德华兹的回应

segments.src: Edwards has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing, telling colleagues and reporters that his actions were misunderstood and that he never intended to make anyone uncomfortable.
segments.tr: 爱德华兹一再否认有任何不当行为，他告诉同事和记者，他的行为被误解了，他从未打算让任何人感到不舒服。

segments.src: In a statement following the vote, he said he respected the House's decision even as he continued to dispute several of the committee's characterizations of his conduct.
segments.tr: 在投票后的一份声明中，他说他尊重众议院的决定，同时继续对委员会对其行为的若干定性提出异议。

segments.src: He has not been accused of, nor has the committee alleged, any criminal behavior.
segments.tr: 他没有被指控有任何犯罪行为，委员会也没有指控任何犯罪行为。

segments.src: Ethics investigations of this kind focus on workplace conduct standards for House employees rather than criminal law, and the censure itself carries no legal penalty.
segments.tr: 这种道德调查侧重于众议院员工的工作场所行为标准，而不是刑法，谴责本身也没有法律惩罚。

segments.src: It is, instead, a formal statement of disapproval from Edwards' peers.
segments.tr: 相反，它是爱德华兹同僚对其不赞成的正式声明。

segments.src: ## Political Fallout
segments.tr: ## 政治影响

segments.src: The controversy has already reshaped Edwards' political future.
segments.tr: 这场争议已经重塑了爱德华兹的政治未来。

segments.src: He announced weeks before the ethics report's release that he would not seek re-election, a decision his office described as unrelated to the ongoing investigation at the time.
segments.tr: 他在道德报告发布前几周宣布他将不寻求连任，他的办公室当时将这一决定描述为与正在进行的调查无关。

segments.src: Since then, several North Carolina Republicans have moved to position themselves as potential successors in his district.
segments.tr: 从那时起，几位北卡罗来纳州共和党人已经采取行动，将自己定位为他所在选区的潜在继任者。

segments.src: House leaders on both sides of the aisle framed the vote as a signal about workplace expectations on Capitol Hill, a topic that has drawn periodic scrutiny since a wave of harassment-related resignations and investigations in Congress over the past decade.
segments.tr: 两党众议院领导人都将这次投票描述为关于国会山工作场所期望的信号，自过去十年国会爆发与骚扰相关的辞职和调查浪潮以来，这个话题定期引起审查。

segments.src: Speaker's office aides and Democratic leadership alike encouraged members to support the resolution, contributing to the vote's overwhelming margin.
segments.tr: 议长办公室助理和民主党领导层都鼓励成员支持该决议，从而促成了压倒性的投票优势。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: With censure now formalized, Edwards remains a sitting member of Congress through the end of his term, retaining his committee assignments and voting rights.
segments.tr: 随着谴责的正式化，爱德华兹在任期结束前仍然是现任国会议员，保留其委员会职务和投票权。

segments.src: Unlike expulsion, censure does not remove a member from office.
segments.tr: 与开除不同，谴责不会将议员撤职。

segments.src: Attention now turns to the open seat in his district, where the coming primary is expected to draw a crowded Republican field as the party looks to hold the seat in the next general election.
segments.tr: 注意力现在转向了他选区的空缺席位，随着该党希望在下一次大选中保持该席位，即将到来的初选预计将吸引拥挤的共和党候选人。

segments.src: The Ethics Committee has not indicated whether any further action is planned, and Edwards' office says he intends to serve out the remainder of his term.
segments.tr: 道德委员会尚未表明是否计划采取进一步行动，爱德华兹的办公室表示，他打算完成剩余的任期。

segments.tr: निंदा के लिए सदस्य को हाउस के वेल में खड़े होने की आवश्यकता होती है जबकि प्रस्ताव को जोर से पढ़ा जाता है - एक सार्वजनिक लेखा जो कि हाल के congressional इतिहास में केवल कुछ ही बार उपयोग किया गया है।

segments.src: For Edwards, the vote marks a dramatic and humbling turn in a career that, until this year, had drawn little national attention.
segments.tr: एडवर्ड्स के लिए, यह वोट एक ऐसे करियर में एक नाटकीय और विनम्र मोड़ को चिह्नित करता है, जो इस वर्ष तक, बहुत कम राष्ट्रीय ध्यान आकर्षित कर चुका था।

segments.src: ## What the Ethics Investigation Found
segments.tr: ## एथिक्स इन्वेस्टिगेशन ने क्या पाया

segments.src: According to the House Ethics Committee's report, Edwards showered two former aides with expensive gifts, private dinners and personally written poetry over an extended period.
segments.tr: हाउस एथिक्स कमेटी की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, एडवर्ड्स ने एक विस्तारित अवधि में दो पूर्व सहायकों को महंगे उपहार, निजी डिनर और व्यक्तिगत रूप से लिखी गई कविता से नवाजा।

segments.src: Investigators concluded that this pattern of behavior created a hostile and uncomfortable work environment for the staffers involved, even though the committee said it found no evidence of a sexual relationship between Edwards and either aide.
segments.tr: जांचकर्ताओं ने निष्कर्ष निकाला कि व्यवहार के इस पैटर्न ने शामिल कर्मचारियों के लिए एक शत्रुतापूर्ण और असहज कार्य वातावरण बनाया, भले ही समिति ने कहा कि उसे एडवर्ड्स और दोनों सहायकों में से किसी के बीच यौन संबंध का कोई सबूत नहीं मिला।

segments.src: The report emphasized that the imbalance of power between a sitting member of Congress and junior staff members was central to its conclusions.
segments.tr: रिपोर्ट में इस बात पर जोर दिया गया कि कांग्रेस के बैठे सदस्य और कनिष्ठ कर्मचारियों के बीच शक्ति का असंतुलन इसके निष्कर्षों के केंद्र में था।

segments.src: Investigators noted that gifts and personal attention of this kind, regardless of intent, can place employees in an untenable position — unable to easily decline or object without risking their jobs or standing within the office.
segments.tr: जांचकर्ताओं ने नोट किया कि इस प्रकार के उपहार और व्यक्तिगत ध्यान, इरादे की परवाह किए बिना, कर्मचारियों को एक दयनीय स्थिति में डाल सकते हैं - अपनी नौकरियों या कार्यालय के भीतर स्थिति को जोखिम में डाले बिना आसानी से अस्वीकार करने या आपत्ति करने में असमर्थ।

segments.src: Committee members from both parties said the evidence, including internal communications and witness testimony gathered over months, was consistent enough to support formal action.
segments.tr: दोनों पक्षों के समिति के सदस्यों ने कहा कि महीनों में एकत्र किए गए आंतरिक संचार और गवाहों की गवाही सहित सबूत, औपचारिक कार्रवाई का समर्थन करने के लिए पर्याप्त सुसंगत थे।

segments.src: The near-unanimous floor vote reflected that consensus, with only two members voting against the censure resolution.
segments.tr: लगभग सर्वसम्मत फ्लोर वोट ने उस आम सहमति को दर्शाया, जिसमें केवल दो सदस्यों ने निंदा प्रस्ताव के खिलाफ मतदान किया।

segments.src: ## Edwards' Response
segments.tr: ## एडवर्ड्स की प्रतिक्रिया

segments.src: Edwards has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing, telling colleagues and reporters that his actions were misunderstood and that he never intended to make anyone uncomfortable.
segments.tr: एडवर्ड्स ने बार-बार किसी भी गलत काम से इनकार किया है, सहयोगियों और संवाददाताओं से कहा कि उनके कार्यों को गलत समझा गया था और उन्होंने कभी भी किसी को असहज करने का इरादा नहीं किया था।

segments.src: In a statement following the vote, he said he respected the House's decision even as he continued to dispute several of the committee's characterizations of his conduct.
segments.tr: वोट के बाद एक बयान में, उन्होंने कहा कि उन्होंने सदन के फैसले का सम्मान किया, भले ही वह अपने आचरण के समिति के कई चरित्रचित्रणों पर विवाद करना जारी रखा।

segments.src: He has not been accused of, nor has the committee alleged, any criminal behavior.
segments.tr: उन पर किसी भी आपराधिक व्यवहार का आरोप नहीं लगाया गया है, न ही समिति ने आरोप लगाया है।

segments.src: Ethics investigations of this kind focus on workplace conduct standards for House employees rather than criminal law, and the censure itself carries no legal penalty.
segments.tr: इस तरह की एथिक्स जांच आपराधिक कानून के बजाय हाउस के कर्मचारियों के लिए कार्यस्थल आचरण मानकों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करती है, और निंदा अपने आप में कोई कानूनी दंड नहीं लेती है।

segments.src: It is, instead, a formal statement of disapproval from Edwards' peers.
segments.tr: यह, इसके बजाय, एडवर्ड्स के साथियों की अस्वीकृति का एक औपचारिक बयान है।

segments.src: ## Political Fallout
segments.tr: ## राजनीतिक fallout

segments.src: The controversy has already reshaped Edwards' political future.
segments.tr: विवाद ने पहले ही एडवर्ड्स के राजनीतिक भविष्य को नया रूप दे दिया है।

segments.src: He announced weeks before the ethics report's release that he would not seek re-election, a decision his office described as unrelated to the ongoing investigation at the time.
segments.tr: उन्होंने एथिक्स रिपोर्ट जारी होने के हफ्तों पहले घोषणा की थी कि वह फिर से चुनाव नहीं मांगेंगे, एक निर्णय जिसे उनके कार्यालय ने उस समय चल रही जांच से असंबंधित बताया था।

segments.src: Since then, several North Carolina Republicans have moved to position themselves as potential successors in his district.
segments.tr: तब से, कई नॉर्थ कैरोलिना रिपब्लिकन ने अपने जिले में संभावित उत्तराधिकारियों के रूप में खुद को स्थापित करने के लिए कदम बढ़ाया है।

segments.src: House leaders on both sides of the aisle framed the vote as a signal about workplace expectations on Capitol Hill, a topic that has drawn periodic scrutiny since a wave of harassment-related resignations and investigations in Congress over the past decade.
segments.tr: गलियारे के दोनों किनारों पर हाउस के नेताओं ने वोट को कैपिटल हिल पर कार्यस्थल की अपेक्षाओं के बारे में एक संकेत के रूप में तैयार किया, एक विषय जिसने पिछले दशक में कांग्रेस में उत्पीड़न से संबंधित इस्तीफे और जांच की एक लहर के बाद से आवधिक जांच आकर्षित की है।

segments.src: Speaker's office aides and Democratic leadership alike encouraged members to support the resolution, contributing to the vote's overwhelming margin.
segments.tr: स्पीकर के कार्यालय के सहायकों और डेमोक्रेटिक नेतृत्व दोनों ने सदस्यों को प्रस्ताव का समर्थन करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया, जिससे वोट के भारी अंतर में योगदान मिला।

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होता है

segments.src: With censure now formalized, Edwards remains a sitting member of Congress through the end of his term, retaining his committee assignments and voting rights.
segments.tr: निंदा के अब औपचारिक हो जाने के साथ, एडवर्ड्स अपने कार्यकाल के अंत तक कांग्रेस के एक बैठे सदस्य बने हुए हैं, अपने समिति के असाइनमेंट और मतदान के अधिकारों को बनाए रखते हुए।

segments.src: Unlike expulsion, censure does not remove a member from office.
segments.tr: निष्कासन के विपरीत, निंदा किसी सदस्य को कार्यालय से नहीं हटाती है।

segments.src: Attention now turns to the open seat in his district, where the coming primary is expected to draw a crowded Republican field as the party looks to hold the seat in the next general election.
segments.tr: ध्यान अब उनके जिले में खुली सीट पर जाता है, जहां आने वाले प्राथमिक से एक भीड़भाड़ वाले रिपब्लिकन क्षेत्र को आकर्षित करने की उम्मीद है क्योंकि पार्टी अगले आम चुनाव में सीट रखती है।

segments.src: The Ethics Committee has not indicated whether any further action is planned, and Edwards' office says he intends to serve out the remainder of his term.
segments.tr: एथिक्स कमेटी ने यह संकेत नहीं दिया है कि क्या कोई और कार्रवाई की योजना बनाई गई है, और एडवर्ड्स का कार्यालय कहता है कि वह अपने कार्यकाल के शेष हिस्से की सेवा करने का इरादा रखता है।

es.title: La Cámara vota 413-2 para censurar al representante Chuck Edwards por su trato a empleadas

segments.src: ## A Rare Show of Bipartisan Unity
segments.tr: ## Una rara muestra de unidad bipartidista

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: La

segments.src: House of Representatives voted 413 to 2 to censure Rep.
segments.tr: Cámara de Representantes de EE. UU. votó 413 a 2 para censurar al rep.

segments.src: Chuck Edwards, R-N.C., following a bipartisan ethics investigation into his conduct toward two young female staffers.
segments.tr: Chuck Edwards, republicano por Carolina del Norte, tras una investigación ética bipartidista sobre su conducta hacia dos jóvenes empleadas.

segments.src: The lopsided tally made clear that lawmakers from both parties viewed the findings as serious enough to warrant one of the chamber's most severe formal rebukes short of expulsion.
segments.tr: El abrumador recuento dejó claro que los legisladores de ambos partidos consideraron que los hallazgos eran lo suficientemente graves como para justificar una de las reprensiones formales más severas de la cámara, después de la expulsión.

segments.src: Censure requires the member to stand in the well of the House while the resolution is read aloud — a public accounting that has been used only a handful of times in recent congressional history.
segments.tr: La censura requiere que el miembro se pare en el estrado de la Cámara mientras se lee en voz alta la resolución, una rendición de cuentas pública que se ha utilizado solo un puñado de veces en la historia reciente del Congreso.

segments.src: For Edwards, the vote marks a dramatic and humbling turn in a career that, until this year, had drawn little national attention.
segments.tr: Para Edwards, la votación marca un giro dramático y humillante en una carrera que, hasta este año, había atraído poca atención nacional.

segments.src: ## What the Ethics Investigation Found
segments.tr: ## Lo que encontró la investigación ética

segments.src: According to the House Ethics Committee's report, Edwards showered two former aides with expensive gifts, private dinners and personally written poetry over an extended period.
segments.tr: Según el informe del Comité de Ética de la Cámara, Edwards colmó a dos exasistentes con regalos caros, cenas privadas y poesía escrita por él mismo durante un período prolongado.

segments.src: Investigators concluded that this pattern of behavior created a hostile and uncomfortable work environment for the staffers involved, even though the committee said it found no evidence of a sexual relationship between Edwards and either aide.
segments.tr: Los investigadores concluyeron que este patrón de comportamiento creó un ambiente de trabajo hostil e incómodo para las empleadas involucradas, a pesar de que el comité afirmó que no encontró evidencia de una relación sexual entre Edwards y ninguna de las asistentes.

segments.src: The report emphasized that the imbalance of power between a sitting member of Congress and junior staff members was central to its conclusions.
segments.tr: El informe enfatizó que el desequilibrio de poder entre un miembro en funciones del Congreso y los miembros del personal subalterno fue fundamental para sus conclusiones.

segments.src: Investigators noted that gifts and personal attention of this kind, regardless of intent, can place employees in an untenable position — unable to easily decline or object without risking their jobs or standing within the office.
segments.tr: Los investigadores señalaron que los regalos y la atención personal de este tipo, independientemente de la intención, pueden colocar a los empleados en una posición insostenible, incapaces de rechazar u objetar fácilmente sin arriesgar sus empleos o su posición dentro de la oficina.

segments.src: Committee members from both parties said the evidence, including internal communications and witness testimony gathered over months, was consistent enough to support formal action.
segments.tr: Los miembros del comité de ambos partidos dijeron que la evidencia, que incluye comunicaciones internas y testimonios de testigos reunidos durante meses, era lo suficientemente consistente como para respaldar una acción formal.

segments.src: The near-unanimous floor vote reflected that consensus, with only two members voting against the censure resolution.
segments.tr: La votación en el pleno, casi unánime, reflejó ese consenso, con solo dos miembros votando en contra de la resolución de censura.

segments.src: ## Edwards' Response
segments.tr: ## Respuesta de Edwards

segments.src: Edwards has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing, telling colleagues and reporters that his actions were misunderstood and that he never intended to make anyone uncomfortable.
segments.tr: Edwards ha negado repetidamente cualquier mala conducta, diciendo a sus colegas y reporteros que sus acciones fueron malinterpretadas y que nunca tuvo la intención de hacer sentir incómodo a nadie.

segments.src: In a statement following the vote, he said he respected the House's decision even as he continued to dispute several of the committee's characterizations of his conduct.
segments.tr: En una declaración posterior a la votación, dijo que respetaba la decisión de la Cámara aun cuando continuaba cuestionando varias de las caracterizaciones del comité sobre su conducta.

segments.src: He has not been accused of, nor has the committee alleged, any criminal behavior.
segments.tr: No ha sido acusado de ningún comportamiento criminal, ni el comité ha alegado tal cosa.

segments.src: Ethics investigations of this kind focus on workplace conduct standards for House employees rather than criminal law, and the censure itself carries no legal penalty.
segments.tr: Las investigaciones éticas de este tipo se centran en los estándares de conducta laboral para los empleados de la Cámara en lugar de en el derecho penal, y la censura en sí no conlleva ninguna sanción legal.

segments.src: It is, instead, a formal statement of disapproval from Edwards' peers.
segments.tr: Es, en cambio, una declaración formal de desaprobación por parte de los colegas de Edwards.

segments.src: ## Political Fallout
segments.tr: ## Repercusiones políticas

segments.src: The controversy has already reshaped Edwards' political future.
segments.tr: La controversia ya ha redefinido el futuro político de Edwards.

segments.src: He announced weeks before the ethics report's release that he would not seek re-election, a decision his office described as unrelated to the ongoing investigation at the time.
segments.tr: Anunció semanas antes de la publicación del informe de ética que no buscaría la reelección, una decisión que su oficina describió en su momento como no relacionada con la investigación en curso.

segments.src: Since then, several North Carolina Republicans have moved to position themselves as potential successors in his district.
segments.tr: Desde entonces, varios republicanos de Carolina del Norte se han movido para posicionarse como posibles sucesores en su distrito.

segments.src: House leaders on both sides of the aisle framed the vote as a signal about workplace expectations on Capitol Hill, a topic that has drawn periodic scrutiny since a wave of harassment-related resignations and investigations in Congress over the past decade.
segments.tr: Los líderes de la Cámara de ambos partidos enmarcaron la votación como una señal sobre las expectativas laborales en el Capitolio, un tema que ha atraído un escrutinio periódico desde una ola de renuncias e investigaciones relacionadas con el acoso en el Congreso durante la última década.

segments.src: Speaker's office aides and Democratic leadership alike encouraged members to support the resolution, contributing to the vote's overwhelming margin.
segments.tr: Los asesores de la oficina del presidente de la Cámara y el liderazgo demócrata por igual alentaron a los miembros a respaldar la resolución, lo que contribuyó al abrumador margen de la votación.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sucede a continuación

segments.src: With censure now formalized, Edwards remains a sitting member of Congress through the end of his term, retaining his committee assignments and voting rights.
segments.tr: Con la censura ya formalizada, Edwards sigue siendo un miembro en funciones del Congreso hasta el final de su mandato, conservando sus asignaciones en comités y sus derechos de voto.

segments.src: Unlike expulsion, censure does not remove a member from office.
segments.tr: A diferencia de la expulsión, la censura no destituye a un miembro de su cargo.

segments.src: Attention now turns to the open seat in his district, where the coming primary is expected to draw a crowded Republican field as the party looks to hold the seat in the next general election.
segments.tr: La atención ahora se centra en el escaño vacante en su distrito, donde se espera que las próximas primarias atraigan a un concurrido campo republicano mientras el partido busca retener el escaño en las próximas elecciones generales.

segments.src: The Ethics Committee has not indicated whether any further action is planned, and Edwards' office says he intends to serve out the remainder of his term.
segments.tr: El Comité de Ética no ha indicado si se planea alguna acción adicional, y la oficina de Edwards dice que tiene la intención de cumplir el resto de su mandato.

segments.src: Investigators noted that gifts and personal attention of this kind, regardless of intent, can place employees in an untenable position — unable to easily decline or object without risking their jobs or standing within the office.
segments.tr: قال أعضاء اللجنة من كلا الحزبين إن الأدلة، بما في ذلك الاتصالات الداخلية وشهادات الشهود التي تم جمعها على مدى أشهر، كانت متسقة بما يكفي لدعم اتخاذ إجراء رسمي.

segments.src: Committee members from both parties said the evidence, including internal communications and witness testimony gathered over months, was consistent enough to support formal action.
segments.tr: عكس تصويت المجلس شبه الإجماعي ذلك التوافق، حيث صوت عضوان فقط ضد قرار التوبيخ.

segments.src: The near-unanimous floor vote reflected that consensus, with only two members voting against the censure resolution.

segments.tr: نفى إدواردز مراراً وتكراراً ارتكاب أي مخالفات، قائلاً لزملائه والصحفيين إن تصرفاته أسيء فهمها وأنه لم يقصد أبداً جعل أي شخص يشعر بعدم الارتياح.

segments.src: In a statement following the vote, he said he respected the House's decision even as he continued to dispute several of the committee's characterizations of his conduct.
segments.tr: لم يتم اتهامه، ولم تزعم اللجنة، بأي سلوك إجرامي.

segments.src: He has not been accused of, nor has the committee alleged, any criminal behavior.

segments.src: Ethics investigations of this kind focus on workplace conduct standards for House employees rather than criminal law, and the censure itself carries no legal penalty.
segments.tr: إنه، بدلاً من ذلك، بيان رسمي بعدم الموافقة من أقران إدواردز.

segments.src: He announced weeks before the ethics report's release that he would not seek re-election, a decision his office described as unrelated to the ongoing investigation at the time.

segments.src: Since then, several North Carolina Republicans have moved to position themselves as potential successors in his district.

segments.src: House leaders on both sides of the aisle framed the vote as a signal about workplace expectations on Capitol Hill, a topic that has drawn periodic scrutiny since a wave of harassment-related resignations and investigations in Congress over the past decade.

segments.src: Speaker's office aides and Democratic leadership alike encouraged members to support the resolution, contributing to the vote's overwhelming margin.
segments.tr: ## ماذا سيحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: With censure now formalized, Edwards remains a sitting member of Congress through the end of his term, retaining his committee assignments and voting rights.
segments.tr: على عكس الطرد، لا يؤدي التوبيخ إلى إقالة العضو من منصبه.

segments.src: Unlike expulsion, censure does not remove a member from office.
segments.tr: ينصب الاهتمام الآن على المقعد الشاغر في دائرته الانتخابية، حيث من المتوقع أن تجذب الانتخابات التمهيدية القادمة عدداً كبيراً من المرشحين الجمهوريين بينما يتطلع الحزب إلى الاحتفاظ بالمقعد في الانتخابات العامة المقبلة.

segments.src: Attention now turns to the open seat in his district, where the coming primary is expected to draw a crowded Republican field as the party looks to hold the seat in the next general election.
segments.tr: لم تشر لجنة الأخلاقيات إلى ما إذا كان من المخطط اتخاذ أي إجراء آخر، ويقول مكتب إدواردز إنه يعتزم إكمال ما تبقى من فترة ولايته.

segments.src: The Ethics Committee has not indicated whether any further action is planned, and Edwards' office says he intends to serve out the remainder of his term.

fr.title: La Chambre vote à 413 contre 2 pour blâmer le représentant Chuck Edwards en raison de son comportement envers des collaboratrices

segments.src: ## A Rare Show of Bipartisan Unity
segments.tr: ## Une rare démonstration d'unité bipartisane

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: La

segments.src: House of Representatives voted 413 to 2 to censure Rep.
segments.tr: Chambre des représentants des États-Unis a voté par 413 voix contre 2 pour blâmer le représentant

segments.src: Chuck Edwards, R-N.C., following a bipartisan ethics investigation into his conduct toward two young female staffers.
segments.tr: Chuck Edwards, républicain de Caroline du Nord, à la suite d'une enquête éthique bipartisane sur sa conduite envers deux jeunes collaboratrices.

segments.src: The lopsided tally made clear that lawmakers from both parties viewed the findings as serious enough to warrant one of the chamber's most severe formal rebukes short of expulsion.
segments.tr: Ce résultat écrasant a clairement montré que les parlementaires des deux partis ont jugé les conclusions suffisamment graves pour justifier l'une des réprimandes officielles les plus sévères de la Chambre, juste avant l'expulsion.

segments.src: Censure requires the member to stand in the well of the House while the resolution is read aloud — a public accounting that has been used only a handful of times in recent congressional history.
segments.tr: Le blâme exige que le membre se tienne au centre de l'hémicycle de la Chambre pendant que la résolution est lue à haute voix — une demande de comptes publique qui n'a été utilisée qu'une poignée de fois dans l'histoire récente du Congrès.

segments.src: For Edwards, the vote marks a dramatic and humbling turn in a career that, until this year, had drawn little national attention.
segments.tr: Pour Edwards, ce vote marque un tournant dramatique et humilant dans une carrière qui, jusqu'à cette année, avait attiré peu d'attention nationale.

segments.src: ## What the Ethics Investigation Found
segments.tr: ## Ce que l'enquête éthique a révélé

segments.src: According to the House Ethics Committee's report, Edwards showered two former aides with expensive gifts, private dinners and personally written poetry over an extended period.
segments.tr: Selon le rapport du Comité d'éthique de la Chambre, Edwards a couvert deux anciennes collaboratrices de cadeaux coûteux, de dîners privés et de poèmes écrits de sa main sur une période prolongée.

segments.src: Investigators concluded that this pattern of behavior created a hostile and uncomfortable work environment for the staffers involved, even though the committee said it found no evidence of a sexual relationship between Edwards and either aide.
segments.tr: Les enquêteurs ont conclu que ce schéma de comportement a créé un environnement de travail hostile et inconfortable pour les collaboratrices concernées, même si le comité a déclaré n'avoir trouvé aucune preuve de relation sexuelle entre Edwards et l'une ou l'autre des assistantes.

segments.src: The report emphasized that the imbalance of power between a sitting member of Congress and junior staff members was central to its conclusions.
segments.tr: Le rapport a souligné que le déséquilibre de pouvoir entre un membre du Congrès en exercice et des membres du personnel junior était au cœur de ses conclusions.

segments.src: Investigators noted that gifts and personal attention of this kind, regardless of intent, can place employees in an untenable position — unable to easily decline or object without risking their jobs or standing within the office.
segments.tr: Les enquêteurs ont noté que des cadeaux et une attention personnelle de ce type, quelle que soit l'intention, peuvent placer les employés dans une position intenable — incapables de refuser ou de s'opposer facilement sans risquer leur emploi ou leur position au sein du bureau.

segments.src: Committee members from both parties said the evidence, including internal communications and witness testimony gathered over months, was consistent enough to support formal action.
segments.tr: Les membres du comité des deux partis ont déclaré que les preuves, y compris les communications internes et les témoignages recueillis pendant des mois, étaient suffisamment cohérentes pour justifier une action officielle.

segments.src: The near-unanimous floor vote reflected that consensus, with only two members voting against the censure resolution.
segments.tr: Le vote quasi unanime de l'assemblée a reflété ce consensus, avec seulement deux membres votant contre la résolution de blâme.

segments.src: ## Edwards' Response
segments.tr: ## La réaction d'Edwards

segments.src: Edwards has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing, telling colleagues and reporters that his actions were misunderstood and that he never intended to make anyone uncomfortable.
segments.tr: Edwards a répété à plusieurs reprises n'avoir rien fait de mal, affirmant à ses collègues et aux journalistes que ses actions avaient été mal interprétées et qu'il n'avait jamais eu l'intention de mettre quiconque mal à l'aise.

segments.src: In a statement following the vote, he said he respected the House's decision even as he continued to dispute several of the committee's characterizations of his conduct.
segments.tr: Dans une déclaration faisant suite au vote, il a déclaré respecter la décision de la Chambre tout en continuant de contester plusieurs des caractérisations de sa conduite faites par le comité.

segments.src: He has not been accused of, nor has the committee alleged, any criminal behavior.
segments.tr: Il n'a pas été accusé de comportement criminel, et le comité n'en a pas non plus allégué.

segments.src: Ethics investigations of this kind focus on workplace conduct standards for House employees rather than criminal law, and the censure itself carries no legal penalty.
segments.tr: Les enquêtes éthiques de ce type se concentrent sur les normes de conduite sur le lieu de travail pour les employés de la Chambre plutôt que sur le droit pénal, et le blâme lui-même ne comporte aucune sanction juridique.

segments.src: It is, instead, a formal statement of disapproval from Edwards' peers.
segments.tr: Il s'agit plutôt d'une déclaration officielle de désapprobation de la part des pairs d'Edwards.

segments.src: ## Political Fallout
segments.tr: ## Retombées politiques

segments.src: The controversy has already reshaped Edwards' political future.
segments.tr: La controverse a déjà redéfini l'avenir politique d'Edwards.

segments.src: He announced weeks before the ethics report's release that he would not seek re-election, a decision his office described as unrelated to the ongoing investigation at the time.
segments.tr: Il a annoncé des semaines avant la publication du rapport d'éthique qu'il ne briguerait pas un nouveau mandat, une décision que son bureau a décrite comme sans lien avec l'enquête en cours à l'époque.

segments.src: Since then, several North Carolina Republicans have moved to position themselves as potential successors in his district.
segments.tr: Depuis lors, plusieurs républicains de Caroline du Nord se sont positionnés comme successeurs potentiels dans sa circonscription.

segments.src: House leaders on both sides of the aisle framed the vote as a signal about workplace expectations on Capitol Hill, a topic that has drawn periodic scrutiny since a wave of harassment-related resignations and investigations in Congress over the past decade.
segments.tr: Les dirigeants de la Chambre des deux côtés de l'échiquier politique ont présenté ce vote comme un signal concernant les attentes sur le lieu de travail au Capitole, un sujet qui a suscité une attention périodique depuis une vague de démissions et d'enquêtes liées au harcèlement au Congrès au cours de la dernière décennie.

segments.src: Speaker's office aides and Democratic leadership alike encouraged members to support the resolution, contributing to the vote's overwhelming margin.
segments.tr: Les assistants du bureau du président et la direction démocrate ont tous deux encouragé les membres à soutenir la résolution, contribuant à la marge écrasante du vote.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Que se passe-t-il ensuite

segments.src: With censure now formalized, Edwards remains a sitting member of Congress through the end of his term, retaining his committee assignments and voting rights.
segments.tr: Le blâme étant désormais officialisé, Edwards reste un membre en exercice du Congrès jusqu'à la fin de son mandat, conservant ses attributions au sein des comités et ses droits de vote.

segments.src: Unlike expulsion, censure does not remove a member from office.
segments.tr: Contrairement à l'expulsion, le blâme ne destitue pas un membre de ses fonctions.

segments.src: Attention now turns to the open seat in his district, where the coming primary is expected to draw a crowded Republican field as the party looks to hold the seat in the next general election.
segments.tr: L'attention se tourne maintenant vers le siège vacant dans sa circonscription, où la primaire à venir devrait attirer un grand nombre de candidats républicains alors que le parti cherche à conserver le siège lors des prochaines élections générales.

segments.src: The Ethics Committee has not indicated whether any further action is planned, and Edwards' office says he intends to serve out the remainder of his term.
segments.tr: Le Comité d'éthique n'a pas indiqué si d'autres mesures étaient prévues, et le bureau d'Edwards indique qu'il a l'intention de servir jusqu'à la fin de son mandat.

pt.title: A Câmara vota por 413 a 2 para censurar o deputado Chuck Edwards devido ao tratamento dado a assessoras

segments.src: ## A Rare Show of Bipartisan Unity
segments.tr: ## Uma Rara Demonstração de Unidade Bipartidária

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: A

segments.src: House of Representatives voted 413 to 2 to censure Rep.
segments.tr: Câmara dos Representantes dos EUA votou por 413 a 2 para censurar o deputado

segments.src: Chuck Edwards, R-N.C., following a bipartisan ethics investigation into his conduct toward two young female staffers.
segments.tr: Chuck Edwards, republicano da Carolina do Norte, após uma investigação ética bipartidária sobre sua conduta em relação a duas jovens assessoras.

segments.src: The lopsided tally made clear that lawmakers from both parties viewed the findings as serious enough to warrant one of the chamber's most severe formal rebukes short of expulsion.
segments.tr: A votação desigual deixou claro que os legisladores de ambos os partidos consideraram as conclusões sérias o suficiente para justificar uma das repreensões formais mais severas da câmara, ficando atrás apenas da expulsão.

segments.src: Censure requires the member to stand in the well of the House while the resolution is read aloud — a public accounting that has been used only a handful of times in recent congressional history.
segments.tr: A censura exige que o membro permaneça no plenário da Câmara enquanto a resolução é lida em voz alta — uma prestação de contas pública que foi usada apenas algumas vezes na história recente do Congresso.

segments.src: For Edwards, the vote marks a dramatic and humbling turn in a career that, until this year, had drawn little national attention.
segments.tr: Para Edwards, a votação marca uma reviravolta dramática e humilhante em uma carreira que, até este ano, havia atraído pouca atenção nacional.

segments.src: ## What the Ethics Investigation Found
segments.tr: ## O que a Investigação Ética Descobriu

segments.src: According to the House Ethics Committee's report, Edwards showered two former aides with expensive gifts, private dinners and personally written poetry over an extended period.
segments.tr: De acordo com o relatório do Comitê de Ética da Câmara, Edwards cobriu duas ex-assessoras com presentes caros, jantares privados e poesias escritas pessoalmente por um longo período.

segments.src: Investigators concluded that this pattern of behavior created a hostile and uncomfortable work environment for the staffers involved, even though the committee said it found no evidence of a sexual relationship between Edwards and either aide.
segments.tr: Os investigadores concluíram que esse padrão de comportamento criou um ambiente de trabalho hostil e desconfortável para as assessoras envolvidas, embora o comitê tenha afirmado não ter encontrado evidências de um relacionamento sexual entre Edwards e nenhuma das assessoras.

segments.src: The report emphasized that the imbalance of power between a sitting member of Congress and junior staff members was central to its conclusions.
segments.tr: O relatório enfatizou que o desequilíbrio de poder entre um membro em exercício do Congresso e os funcionários juniores foi fundamental para suas conclusões.

segments.src: Investigators noted that gifts and personal attention of this kind, regardless of intent, can place employees in an untenable position — unable to easily decline or object without risking their jobs or standing within the office.
segments.tr: Os investigadores observaram que presentes e atenção pessoal desse tipo, independentemente da intenção, podem colocar os funcionários em uma posição insustentável — incapazes de recusar ou objetar facilmente sem arriscar seus empregos ou posição dentro do escritório.

segments.src: Committee members from both parties said the evidence, including internal communications and witness testimony gathered over months, was consistent enough to support formal action.
segments.tr: Membros do comitê de ambos os partidos disseram que as evidências, incluindo comunicações internas e depoimentos de testemunhas coletados ao longo de meses, foram consistentes o suficiente para apoiar uma ação formal.

segments.src: The near-unanimous floor vote reflected that consensus, with only two members voting against the censure resolution.
segments.tr: A votação em plenário quase unânime refletiu esse consenso, com apenas dois membros votando contra a resolução de censura.

segments.src: ## Edwards' Response
segments.tr: ## A Resposta de Edwards

segments.src: Edwards has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing, telling colleagues and reporters that his actions were misunderstood and that he never intended to make anyone uncomfortable.
segments.tr: Edwards negou repetidamente qualquer irregularidade, dizendo a colegas e repórteres que suas ações foram mal interpretadas e que ele nunca teve a intenção de deixar ninguém desconfortável.

segments.src: In a statement following the vote, he said he respected the House's decision even as he continued to dispute several of the committee's characterizations of his conduct.
segments.tr: Em uma declaração após a votação, ele disse que respeitava a decisão da Câmara, mesmo continuando a contestar várias das caracterizações do comitê sobre sua conduta.

segments.src: He has not been accused of, nor has the committee alleged, any criminal behavior.
segments.tr: Ele não foi acusado, nem o comitê alegou, qualquer comportamento criminoso.

segments.src: Ethics investigations of this kind focus on workplace conduct standards for House employees rather than criminal law, and the censure itself carries no legal penalty.
segments.tr: Investigações éticas desse tipo concentram-se em padrões de conduta no local de trabalho para funcionários da Câmara, em vez de direito penal, e a censura em si não traz nenhuma penalidade legal.

segments.src: It is, instead, a formal statement of disapproval from Edwards' peers.
segments.tr: É, em vez disso, uma declaração formal de desaprovação por parte dos pares de Edwards.

segments.src: ## Political Fallout
segments.tr: ## Consequências Políticas

segments.src: The controversy has already reshaped Edwards' political future.
segments.tr: A controvérsia já remodelou o futuro político de Edwards.

segments.src: He announced weeks before the ethics report's release that he would not seek re-election, a decision his office described as unrelated to the ongoing investigation at the time.
segments.tr: Ele anunciou semanas antes da divulgação do relatório de ética que não buscaria a reeleição, decisão que seu escritório descreveu como não relacionada à investigação em andamento na época.

segments.src: Since then, several North Carolina Republicans have moved to position themselves as potential successors in his district.
segments.tr: Desde então, vários republicanos da Carolina do Norte se movimentaram para se posicionar como potenciais sucessores em seu distrito.

segments.src: House leaders on both sides of the aisle framed the vote as a signal about workplace expectations on Capitol Hill, a topic that has drawn periodic scrutiny since a wave of harassment-related resignations and investigations in Congress over the past decade.
segments.tr: Líderes da Câmara de ambos os lados do corredor enquadraram a votação como um sinal sobre as expectativas no local de trabalho no Capitólio, um tópico que tem atraído escrutínio periódico desde uma onda de renúncias e investigações relacionadas a assédio no Congresso na última década.

segments.src: Speaker's office aides and Democratic leadership alike encouraged members to support the resolution, contributing to the vote's overwhelming margin.
segments.tr: Assessores do gabinete do presidente da Câmara e a liderança democrata encorajaram os membros a apoiar a resolução, contribuindo para a margem esmagadora da votação.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Acontece a Seguir

segments.src: With censure now formalized, Edwards remains a sitting member of Congress through the end of his term, retaining his committee assignments and voting rights.
segments.tr: Com a censura agora formalizada, Edwards permanece como membro em exercício do Congresso até o final de seu mandato, mantendo suas atribuições em comitês e direitos de voto.

segments.src: Unlike expulsion, censure does not remove a member from office.
segments.tr: Ao contrário da expulsão, a censura não remove um membro do cargo.

segments.src: Attention now turns to the open seat in his district, where the coming primary is expected to draw a crowded Republican field as the party looks to hold the seat in the next general election.
segments.tr: A atenção agora se volta para a vaga aberta em seu distrito, onde a próxima primária deve atrair um campo republicano lotado, enquanto o partido busca manter a cadeira na próxima eleição geral.

segments.src: The Ethics Committee has not indicated whether any further action is planned, and Edwards' office says he intends to serve out the remainder of his term.
segments.tr: O Comitê de Ética não indicou se alguma outra ação está planejada, e o gabinete de Edwards diz que ele pretende cumprir o restante de seu mandato.

ja.title: 下院、女性スタッフへの対応をめぐりチャック・エドワーズ議員への問責決議を413対2で可決

segments.src: ## A Rare Show of Bipartisan Unity
segments.tr: ## 超党派の団結を示す異例の展開

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 米

segments.src: House of Representatives voted 413 to 2 to censure Rep.
segments.tr: 下院は、2人の若い女性スタッフに対するチャック・

segments.src: Chuck Edwards, R-N.C., following a bipartisan ethics investigation into his conduct toward two young female staffers.
segments.tr: エドワーズ議員（共和党、ノースカロライナ州）の言動をめぐる超党派の倫理調査を受け、同議員への問責決議を413対2で可決した。

segments.src: The lopsided tally made clear that lawmakers from both parties viewed the findings as serious enough to warrant one of the chamber's most severe formal rebukes short of expulsion.
segments.tr: この圧倒的な票差は、両党の議員が今回の調査結果を、除名に次ぐ議会史上最も重い公式懲戒の一つに値するほど重大なものと捉えていたことを明確に示した。

segments.src: Censure requires the member to stand in the well of the House while the resolution is read aloud — a public accounting that has been used only a handful of times in recent congressional history.
segments.tr: 問責決議では、決議案が朗読される間、対象議員が下院の壇上に起立することが求められる。これは最近の議会史において数えるほどしか行われていない公開の手続きである。

segments.src: For Edwards, the vote marks a dramatic and humbling turn in a career that, until this year, had drawn little national attention.
segments.tr: エドワーズ議員にとってこの採決は、今年に至るまで全国的な注目をほとんど集めていなかったキャリアにおいて、劇的かつ屈辱的な転換点となる。

segments.src: ## What the Ethics Investigation Found
segments.tr: ## 倫理調査で判明したこと

segments.src: According to the House Ethics Committee's report, Edwards showered two former aides with expensive gifts, private dinners and personally written poetry over an extended period.
segments.tr: 下院倫理委員会の報告書によると、エドワーズ議員は長期間にわたり、2人の元補佐官に高価な贈り物、プライベートでの夕食、自作の詩などを贈っていた。

segments.src: Investigators concluded that this pattern of behavior created a hostile and uncomfortable work environment for the staffers involved, even though the committee said it found no evidence of a sexual relationship between Edwards and either aide.
segments.tr: 調査の結果、委員会はエドワーズ議員とどちらの補佐官の間にも性的関係の証拠は見つからなかったとしたものの、こうした一連の行動パターンが関係したスタッフにとって敵対的で居心地の悪い職場環境を作り出したと結論付けた。

segments.src: The report emphasized that the imbalance of power between a sitting member of Congress and junior staff members was central to its conclusions.
segments.tr: 報告書は、現職の国会議員と若手スタッフの間の権力の不均衡が、結論の核心であったと強調している。

segments.src: Investigators noted that gifts and personal attention of this kind, regardless of intent, can place employees in an untenable position — unable to easily decline or object without risking their jobs or standing within the office.
segments.tr: 調査員は、意図に関わらず、こうした贈り物や個人的な配慮は従業員を窮地に追い込む可能性があると指摘した。すなわち、自身の雇用や職場での立場を危うくすることなく、簡単に断ったり異議を唱えたりすることができない状況を生み出すということである。

segments.src: Committee members from both parties said the evidence, including internal communications and witness testimony gathered over months, was consistent enough to support formal action.
segments.tr: 両党の委員会メンバーは、数か月にわたって収集された内部通信や証人証言を含む証拠は、正式な措置を裏付けるのに十分な一貫性があると述べた。

segments.src: The near-unanimous floor vote reflected that consensus, with only two members voting against the censure resolution.
segments.tr: 圧倒的多数による本会議での採決はそのコンセンサスを反映しており、問責決議に反対したのはわずか2名であった。

segments.src: ## Edwards' Response
segments.tr: ## エドワーズ議員の反応

segments.src: Edwards has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing, telling colleagues and reporters that his actions were misunderstood and that he never intended to make anyone uncomfortable.
segments.tr: エドワーズ議員は不正行為を一貫して否定し、同僚や記者団に対し、自分の行動は誤解されたものであり、誰かを不快な気持ちにさせる意図は断じてなかったと語っている。

segments.src: In a statement following the vote, he said he respected the House's decision even as he continued to dispute several of the committee's characterizations of his conduct.
segments.tr: 採決後の声明で同議員は、自身の行動に関する委員会の性格付けのいくつかには異議を唱えつつも、下院の決定を尊重すると述べた。

segments.src: He has not been accused of, nor has the committee alleged, any criminal behavior.
segments.tr: 同議員は刑事責任を問われておらず、委員会もいかなる犯罪行為も主張していない。

segments.src: Ethics investigations of this kind focus on workplace conduct standards for House employees rather than criminal law, and the censure itself carries no legal penalty.
segments.tr: この種の倫理調査は、刑法ではなく下院職員の職場行動基準に焦点を当てるものであり、問責決議自体には法的罰則は伴わない。

segments.src: It is, instead, a formal statement of disapproval from Edwards' peers.
segments.tr: むしろそれは、エドワーズ議員の同僚たちによる正式な不承認の表明である。

segments.src: ## Political Fallout
segments.tr: ## 政治的余波

segments.src: The controversy has already reshaped Edwards' political future.
segments.tr: この波紋はすでにエドワーズ議員の政治的未来を塗り替えている。

segments.src: He announced weeks before the ethics report's release that he would not seek re-election, a decision his office described as unrelated to the ongoing investigation at the time.
segments.tr: 同議員は倫理報告書の公表数週間前に再選を目指さないと発表しており、当時の事務所はこの決定を進行中の倫理調査とは無関係であると説明していた。

segments.src: Since then, several North Carolina Republicans have moved to position themselves as potential successors in his district.
segments.tr: それ以来、ノースカロライナ州の複数の共和党員が、彼の選挙区における後継候補としての地位を確立しようと動き出している。

segments.src: House leaders on both sides of the aisle framed the vote as a signal about workplace expectations on Capitol Hill, a topic that has drawn periodic scrutiny since a wave of harassment-related resignations and investigations in Congress over the past decade.
segments.tr: 両党の下院指導部は今回の採決を、キャピトルヒルにおける職場の期待に関するシグナルとして位置づけた。この話題は、過去10年間に議会でハラスメント関連の辞任や調査の波が起きて以来、定期的に注目を集めてきたものである。

segments.src: Speaker's office aides and Democratic leadership alike encouraged members to support the resolution, contributing to the vote's overwhelming margin.
segments.tr: 議長室の補佐官や民主党指導部も同様に議員に決議案への支持を促し、それが採決での圧倒的な大差につながった。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の展開

segments.src: With censure now formalized, Edwards remains a sitting member of Congress through the end of his term, retaining his committee assignments and voting rights.
segments.tr: 問責が正式なものとなった現在も、エドワーズ議員は任期満了まで現職の議員にとどまり、委員会への配属や投票権を維持する。

segments.src: Unlike expulsion, censure does not remove a member from office.
segments.tr: 除名とは異なり、問責は議員の職を剥奪するものではない。

segments.src: Attention now turns to the open seat in his district, where the coming primary is expected to draw a crowded Republican field as the party looks to hold the seat in the next general election.
segments.tr: 今や関心は、次期一般選挙で党の議席死守を目指すなか、共和党の激しい候補者乱立が予想される彼の選挙区の空席へと向かっている。

segments.src: The Ethics Committee has not indicated whether any further action is planned, and Edwards' office says he intends to serve out the remainder of his term.
segments.tr: 倫理委員会はさらなる措置が計画されているかどうかについて言明しておらず、エドワーズ議員の事務所は、残りの任期を務め上げる意向であると述べている。

segments.tr: Chuck Edwards, Republikaner aus North Carolina, nach einer parteiübergreifenden Ethikuntersuchung zu seinem Verhalten gegenüber zwei jungen Mitarbeiterinnen.

segments.src: The lopsided tally made clear that lawmakers from both parties viewed the findings as serious enough to warrant one of the chamber's most severe formal rebukes short of expulsion.
segments.tr: Das eindeutige Ergebnis machte deutlich, dass die Gesetzgeber beider Parteien die Ergebnisse als schwerwiegend genug ansahen, um eine der schärfsten formellen Rügen der Kammer, abgesehen vom Ausschluss, zu rechtfertigen.

segments.src: Censure requires the member to stand in the well of the House while the resolution is read aloud — a public accounting that has been used only a handful of times in recent congressional history.
segments.tr: Eine Rüge erfordert, dass das Mitglied im Plenum des Repräsentantenhauses steht, während die Resolution laut verlesen wird – eine öffentliche Rechenschaftspflicht, die in der jüngeren Geschichte des Kongresses nur wenige Male angewendet wurde.

segments.src: For Edwards, the vote marks a dramatic and humbling turn in a career that, until this year, had drawn little national attention.
segments.tr: Für Edwards markiert die Abstimmung eine dramatische und demütigende Wende in einer Karriere, die bis zu diesem Jahr kaum nationale Aufmerksamkeit erregt hatte.

segments.src: ## What the Ethics Investigation Found
segments.tr: ## Was die Ethikuntersuchung ergab

segments.src: According to the House Ethics Committee's report, Edwards showered two former aides with expensive gifts, private dinners and personally written poetry over an extended period.
segments.tr: Dem Bericht des Ethikausschusses des Repräsentantenhauses zufolge überhäufte Edwards zwei ehemalige Mitarbeiterinnen über einen längeren Zeitraum mit teuren Geschenken, privaten Abendessen und selbst verfassten Gedichten.

segments.src: Investigators concluded that this pattern of behavior created a hostile and uncomfortable work environment for the staffers involved, even though the committee said it found no evidence of a sexual relationship between Edwards and either aide.
segments.tr: Die Ermittler kamen zu dem Schluss, dass dieses Verhaltensmuster ein feindseliges und unangenehmes Arbeitsumfeld für die betroffenen Mitarbeiterinnen schuf, obwohl der Ausschuss erklärte, keine Beweise für eine sexuelle Beziehung zwischen Edwards und einer der beiden Mitarbeiterinnen gefunden zu haben.

segments.src: The report emphasized that the imbalance of power between a sitting member of Congress and junior staff members was central to its conclusions.
segments.tr: Der Bericht betonte, dass das Machtungleichgewicht zwischen einem amtierenden Kongressabgeordneten und nachgeordneten Mitarbeitern für seine Schlussfolgerungen von zentraler Bedeutung war.

segments.src: Investigators noted that gifts and personal attention of this kind, regardless of intent, can place employees in an untenable position — unable to easily decline or object without risking their jobs or standing within the office.
segments.tr: Die Ermittler stellten fest, dass Geschenke und persönliche Aufmerksamkeit dieser Art, ungeachtet der Absicht, Mitarbeiter in eine unhaltbare Lage bringen können – sie können nicht einfach ablehnen oder widersprechen, ohne ihren Arbeitsplatz oder ihre Stellung im Büro zu gefährden.

segments.src: Committee members from both parties said the evidence, including internal communications and witness testimony gathered over months, was consistent enough to support formal action.
segments.tr: Ausschussmitglieder beider Parteien erklärten, die Beweise, einschließlich interner Kommunikation und Zeugenaussagen, die über Monate gesammelt wurden, seien konsistent genug, um ein formelles Vorgehen zu stützen.

segments.src: The near-unanimous floor vote reflected that consensus, with only two members voting against the censure resolution.
segments.tr: Die nahezu einstimmige Abstimmung im Plenum spiegelte diesen Konsens wider, wobei nur zwei Mitglieder gegen die Rüge-Resolution stimmten.

segments.src: ## Edwards' Response
segments.tr: ## Edwards' Reaktion

segments.src: Edwards has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing, telling colleagues and reporters that his actions were misunderstood and that he never intended to make anyone uncomfortable.
segments.tr: Edwards hat wiederholt jegliches Fehlverhalten bestritten und Kollegen sowie Reportern gegenüber erklärt, seine Handlungen seien missverstanden worden und er habe nie die Absicht gehabt, jemanden in eine unangenehme Lage zu bringen.

segments.src: In a statement following the vote, he said he respected the House's decision even as he continued to dispute several of the committee's characterizations of his conduct.
segments.tr: In einer Erklärung nach der Abstimmung sagte er, er respektiere die Entscheidung des Repräsentantenhauses, auch wenn er weiterhin mehrere Charakterisierungen seines Verhaltens durch den Ausschuss bestreite.

segments.src: He has not been accused of, nor has the committee alleged, any criminal behavior.
segments.tr: Er wurde weder beschuldigt, noch hat der Ausschuss irgendein kriminelles Verhalten behauptet.

segments.src: Ethics investigations of this kind focus on workplace conduct standards for House employees rather than criminal law, and the censure itself carries no legal penalty.
segments.tr: Ethikuntersuchungen dieser Art konzentrieren sich auf Standards für das Arbeitsverhalten von Mitarbeitern des Repräsentantenhauses und nicht auf Strafrecht, und die Rüge selbst hat keine rechtlichen Konsequenzen.

segments.src: It is, instead, a formal statement of disapproval from Edwards' peers.
segments.tr: Es handelt sich stattdessen um eine formelle Missbilligung durch Edwards' Kollegen.

segments.src: ## Political Fallout
segments.tr: ## Politische Folgen

segments.src: The controversy has already reshaped Edwards' political future.
segments.tr: Die Kontroverse hat Edwards' politische Zukunft bereits neu gestaltet.

segments.src: He announced weeks before the ethics report's release that he would not seek re-election, a decision his office described as unrelated to the ongoing investigation at the time.
segments.tr: Er kündigte Wochen vor der Veröffentlichung des Ethikberichts an, dass er nicht für eine Wiederwahl kandidieren werde, eine Entscheidung, die sein Büro damals als unabhängig von der laufenden Untersuchung beschrieb.

segments.src: Since then, several North Carolina Republicans have moved to position themselves as potential successors in his district.
segments.tr: Seitdem haben mehrere Republikaner aus North Carolina begonnen, sich als potenzielle Nachfolger in seinem Wahlkreis zu positionieren.

segments.src: House leaders on both sides of the aisle framed the vote as a signal about workplace expectations on Capitol Hill, a topic that has drawn periodic scrutiny since a wave of harassment-related resignations and investigations in Congress over the past decade.
segments.tr: Führungskräfte des Repräsentantenhauses beider Parteien werteten die Abstimmung als Signal für die Erwartungen an den Arbeitsplatz auf dem Capitol Hill, ein Thema, das seit einer Welle von Rücktritten und Untersuchungen im Zusammenhang mit Belästigung im Kongress im letzten Jahrzehnt regelmäßig unter die Lupe genommen wurde.

segments.src: Speaker's office aides and Democratic leadership alike encouraged members to support the resolution, contributing to the vote's overwhelming margin.
segments.tr: Sowohl Mitarbeiter des Büros des Sprechers als auch die demokratische Führung ermutigten die Mitglieder, die Resolution zu unterstützen, was zu der überwältigenden Mehrheit bei der Abstimmung beitrug.

segments.tr: Da die Rüge nun formalisiert ist, bleibt Edwards bis zum Ende seiner Amtszeit ein amtierendes Mitglied des Kongresses und behält seine Ausschussmandate sowie sein Stimmrecht.

segments.src: Unlike expulsion, censure does not remove a member from office.
segments.tr: Im Gegensatz zum Ausschluss führt eine Rüge nicht zur Entfernung eines Mitglieds aus dem Amt.

segments.src: Attention now turns to the open seat in his district, where the coming primary is expected to draw a crowded Republican field as the party looks to hold the seat in the next general election.
segments.tr: Die Aufmerksamkeit richtet sich nun auf den vakanten Sitz in seinem Wahlkreis, wo bei der kommenden Vorwahl ein großes Feld an republikanischen Bewerbern erwartet wird, da die Partei versucht, den Sitz bei der nächsten allgemeinen Wahl zu halten.

segments.src: The Ethics Committee has not indicated whether any further action is planned, and Edwards' office says he intends to serve out the remainder of his term.

segments.tr: ## Cuộc điều tra đạo đức đã phát hiện những gì

segments.src: According to the House Ethics Committee's report, Edwards showered two former aides with expensive gifts, private dinners and personally written poetry over an extended period.
segments.tr: Theo báo cáo của Ủy ban Đạo đức Hạ viện, Edwards đã tặng hai cựu trợ lý những món quà đắt tiền, các bữa tối riêng tư và những bài thơ do chính ông viết trong một thời gian dài.

segments.src: Investigators concluded that this pattern of behavior created a hostile and uncomfortable work environment for the staffers involved, even though the committee said it found no evidence of a sexual relationship between Edwards and either aide.
segments.tr: Các nhà điều tra kết luận rằng kiểu hành vi này đã tạo ra một môi trường làm việc thù địch và khó chịu cho các nhân viên liên quan, mặc dù ủy ban cho biết họ không tìm thấy bằng chứng về mối quan hệ tình dục giữa Edwards và bất kỳ trợ lý nào.

segments.src: The report emphasized that the imbalance of power between a sitting member of Congress and junior staff members was central to its conclusions.
segments.tr: Báo cáo nhấn mạnh rằng sự mất cân bằng quyền lực giữa một thành viên đương nhiệm của Quốc hội và các nhân viên cấp dưới là trọng tâm trong các kết luận của họ.

segments.src: Investigators noted that gifts and personal attention of this kind, regardless of intent, can place employees in an untenable position — unable to easily decline or object without risking their jobs or standing within the office.
segments.tr: Các nhà điều tra lưu ý rằng những món quà và sự quan tâm cá nhân kiểu này, bất kể ý định là gì, đều có thể đặt nhân viên vào một vị trí không thể chấp nhận được — không thể dễ dàng từ chối hoặc phản đối mà không gây nguy hiểm cho công việc hoặc vị thế của họ trong văn phòng.

segments.src: Committee members from both parties said the evidence, including internal communications and witness testimony gathered over months, was consistent enough to support formal action.
segments.tr: Các thành viên ủy ban từ cả hai đảng cho biết bằng chứng, bao gồm các thông tin liên lạc nội bộ và lời khai của nhân chứng được thu thập trong nhiều tháng, đủ nhất quán để hỗ trợ hành động chính thức.

segments.src: The near-unanimous floor vote reflected that consensus, with only two members voting against the censure resolution.
segments.tr: Cuộc bỏ phiếu gần như nhất trí tại sàn nghị trường phản ánh sự đồng thuận đó, với chỉ hai thành viên bỏ phiếu chống lại nghị quyết khiển trách.

segments.src: ## Edwards' Response
segments.tr: ## Phản hồi của Edwards

segments.src: Edwards has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing, telling colleagues and reporters that his actions were misunderstood and that he never intended to make anyone uncomfortable.
segments.tr: Edwards đã nhiều lần phủ nhận mọi hành vi sai trái, nói với các đồng nghiệp và phóng viên rằng hành động của ông đã bị hiểu lầm và ông không bao giờ có ý định làm bất cứ ai cảm thấy khó chịu.

segments.src: In a statement following the vote, he said he respected the House's decision even as he continued to dispute several of the committee's characterizations of his conduct.
segments.tr: Trong một tuyên bố sau cuộc bỏ phiếu, ông cho biết mình tôn trọng quyết định của Hạ viện ngay cả khi ông tiếp tục tranh cãi về một số mô tả của ủy ban về hành vi của mình.

segments.src: He has not been accused of, nor has the committee alleged, any criminal behavior.
segments.tr: Ông chưa bị buộc tội, và ủy ban cũng không cáo buộc ông có bất kỳ hành vi phạm tội nào.

segments.src: Ethics investigations of this kind focus on workplace conduct standards for House employees rather than criminal law, and the censure itself carries no legal penalty.
segments.tr: Các cuộc điều tra đạo đức kiểu này tập trung vào các tiêu chuẩn hành vi tại nơi làm việc đối với nhân viên Hạ viện thay vì luật hình sự, và bản thân việc khiển trách không mang lại hình phạt pháp lý nào.

segments.src: It is, instead, a formal statement of disapproval from Edwards' peers.
segments.tr: Thay vào đó, đây là một tuyên bố chính thức về sự không tán thành từ các đồng nghiệp của Edwards.

segments.src: ## Political Fallout
segments.tr: ## Hậu quả chính trị

segments.src: The controversy has already reshaped Edwards' political future.
segments.tr: Vụ tranh cãi đã định hình lại tương lai chính trị của Edwards.

segments.src: He announced weeks before the ethics report's release that he would not seek re-election, a decision his office described as unrelated to the ongoing investigation at the time.
segments.tr: Ông đã thông báo vài tuần trước khi báo cáo đạo đức được công bố rằng ông sẽ không tái tranh cử, một quyết định mà văn phòng của ông mô tả là không liên quan đến cuộc điều tra đang diễn ra vào thời điểm đó.

segments.src: Since then, several North Carolina Republicans have moved to position themselves as potential successors in his district.
segments.tr: Kể từ đó, một số đảng viên Cộng hòa tại Bắc Carolina đã bắt đầu định vị bản thân như những người kế nhiệm tiềm năng tại khu vực bầu cử của ông.

segments.src: House leaders on both sides of the aisle framed the vote as a signal about workplace expectations on Capitol Hill, a topic that has drawn periodic scrutiny since a wave of harassment-related resignations and investigations in Congress over the past decade.
segments.tr: Các nhà lãnh đạo Hạ viện từ cả hai phía đã coi cuộc bỏ phiếu là một tín hiệu về các kỳ vọng tại nơi làm việc trên Đồi Capitol, một chủ đề đã thu hút sự giám sát định kỳ kể từ làn sóng từ chức và điều tra liên quan đến quấy rối tại Quốc hội trong thập kỷ qua.

segments.src: Speaker's office aides and Democratic leadership alike encouraged members to support the resolution, contributing to the vote's overwhelming margin.
segments.tr: Các trợ lý văn phòng Chủ tịch Hạ viện và lãnh đạo Đảng Dân chủ đều khuyến khích các thành viên ủng hộ nghị quyết, góp phần vào tỷ lệ bỏ phiếu áp đảo.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Điều gì sẽ xảy ra tiếp theo

segments.src: With censure now formalized, Edwards remains a sitting member of Congress through the end of his term, retaining his committee assignments and voting rights.
segments.tr: Với việc khiển trách hiện đã được chính thức hóa, Edwards vẫn là một thành viên đương nhiệm của Quốc hội cho đến hết nhiệm kỳ, giữ lại các nhiệm vụ ủy ban và quyền bỏ phiếu của mình.

segments.src: Unlike expulsion, censure does not remove a member from office.
segments.tr: Không giống như việc trục xuất, khiển trách không loại bỏ một thành viên khỏi chức vụ.

segments.src: Attention now turns to the open seat in his district, where the coming primary is expected to draw a crowded Republican field as the party looks to hold the seat in the next general election.
segments.tr: Sự chú ý hiện chuyển sang chiếc ghế trống tại khu vực bầu cử của ông, nơi cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ sắp tới dự kiến sẽ thu hút một danh sách đông đảo các ứng cử viên Cộng hòa khi đảng này tìm cách giữ ghế trong cuộc tổng tuyển cử tiếp theo.

segments.src: The Ethics Committee has not indicated whether any further action is planned, and Edwards' office says he intends to serve out the remainder of his term.
segments.tr: Ủy ban Đạo đức chưa cho biết liệu có kế hoạch hành động nào thêm hay không, và văn phòng của Edwards cho biết ông dự định phục vụ hết phần còn lại của nhiệm kỳ.
